correctness.rationale: For y^3-y=x^10+a x^8+x^7 over algebraically closed characteristic 3, one pole of order 10 gives g=9 and p-rank 0. A distinct rational degree-three subfield would violate Castelnuovo-Severi bound g<=4, forcing automorphisms to normalize deck group and preserve infinity. Comparing coefficients of f(ux+v)-eps*f(x)=h^3-h, with deg(h)<=3 and no finite poles, forces u=1,v=0,eps=1, so Aut=C3 for every a. Nine regular x^iy^j dx forms with pole order 3i+10j<=16 form a basis. Explicit Cartier-semilinear images have rank 4 for a=0, rank 5 for a !=0, hence a-number 5 at 0 and 4 elsewhere; independently recomputed full 9x9 image matrix over F3 for a=0,1,2. Geometric coefficient argument, not finite F3 enumeration, covers all algebraic extensions.
